content.title: Paul Skenes’ SI Swim model GF flaunts scorching bikini body that landed her in ‘Baywatch’
content.text: Paul Skenes’ SI Swim model GF flaunts scorching bikini body that landed her in ‘Baywatch’ originally appeared on The Sporting News. Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.Paul Skenes’ girlfriend, gymnastics phenom Livvy Dunne, took to social media to flaunt the SI Swim-worthy — she’s the reigning cover star — bikini body that just helped land her a coveted role on the reboot of the classic TV series Baywatch.In the photo, she lays on the beach studying the barely-there beachwear show’s script — wearing skimpy red bikini bottoms and tight white tank top. She chose quite the angle for the photo.“I’m not a lifeguard, but i play one on tv 🛟 @baywatchtv#baywatch,” she captioned the Saturday, March 14 Instagram share.Her fans, supporters and friends were ecstatic about the announcement.“Wait, this is so funnnn🤩🤩,” wrote WNBA star Sophie Cunningham.“LETS GO BABY,” added Tom Brady’s rumored ex, Brooks Nader, an SI Swim icon who is also on the show. Dunne replied, “I suddenly can’t swim & need to be saved.” A fan added, “Guess between you two ladies I’ll be tuning in.”“HELP I CANT SWIM,” quipped one friend. Dunne answered, “LMAOO MOUTH TO MOUTH.”“Yes, you baddie!!!!” commented Yellowstone star Hassie Harrison. “Cant wait to work with you!!! 🔥😍❤️” Dunne wrote back, “Sooo excited lesssgoo❤️‍🔥.”MORE LIVVY: Livvy Dunne flexes chiseled gymnast’s bod in sizzling ‘SI’ Swim throwbackMORE LIVVY: Liv Dunne’s very cheeky ‘SI’ Swim throwback defies end of bikini season“Here we goooooo!!! 💕🌊” raved Pretty Little Liars actor Shay Mitchell. Dunne responded, “Let’s go save some lives ❤️‍🔥.”Dunne and Pittsburgh Pirates pitcher Skenes, both 23, are high school sweethearts. Dunne rose to fame as an influencer during her days leading the LSU gymnastics team and is on the cover of the current issue of the Sports Illustrated swimsuit issue.READ MORE!
